# Strong Text: <strong>

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Strong Text: <strong>

The <strong> element represents a span of text with strong importance. By default, browsers render strong text in bold. For example,

```html
1<p>For any inquiries, feel free to <strong>contact our support team.</strong></p>
```

Here, the "contact our support team" text is marked as important.
